cues: Opens with "I'll proceed with the ten-step methodology", which explicitly names a specific methodology

Numbered sections map to fixed methodology steps: Classification/Constraints, Dependencies, Key decisions, First end-to-end slice, Phases, Validation checks, Cross-Cutting, AI Layer, Exceptions, Deferred
Uses a reversibility tier vocabulary (R1/R2/R3) on every decision, with default, assumption, validated-by and revisit-trigger columns
Labels thresholds REQUIREMENT / ASSUMPTION / UNKNOWN and uses numbered gates (V0–V6) with hypothesis, method, threshold, evidence and unlocks fields

Ends with a Self-Check that ticks off methodology rules ("all seven rules apply", "Phase 0 is a production first end-to-end slice"), plus a mandatory "AI Layer: N/A" section and a "Plan COMPLETE" sign-off
